fixes.title: Fix: Ignoring explicit purchase intent
fixes.summary: 3 failing runs graded by jev-demo-decision-failure. Evidence: “Prospect said the new plan was all they needed and bought online; the AE cycle added a week and no value.”. Method failure: the fix is a procedure, jev-demos/lead_routing/lh400c-s11/senselab/procedure-ignoring-explicit-purchase-intent, for the next run to follow.

corrective_entry.value: {"goal": "Accept explicit purchase intent or invoicing constraints instead of starting an AE cycle.", "steps": ["Scan the inquiry for: (a) statements that the new plan meets needs or they already bought online; (b) intent to purchase now without requesting a demo; (c) a requirement to purchase via a local vendor or in-country invoicing.", "If they state they already purchased online or that the new plan is all they need: do NOT call decide:route_to_ae; acknowledge the purchase, provide next-step/onboarding guidance, and record as self-serve.", "If they want to proceed now (no demo requested): direct them to complete online checkout and support completion; only involve AE if a custom quote, security/legal review, or complex implementation is requested.", "If they say they purchase via a local vendor or need in-country invoicing: do NOT call decide:route_to_ae; route to the appropriate channel/billing path (reseller or local invoicing workflow) and explain next steps.", "Else (no explicit purchase, no vendor/invoicing requirement, and they request a demo or evaluation): call decide:route_to_ae."], "on_failure": "Stop and summarize which signals (purchase intent, already bought, vendor/in-country invoicing) were found; do not route to AE until the signals are resolved.", "verify": "Before answering, confirm that if the prospect indicated they already purchased online or requires local vendor/in-country invoicing, decide:route_to_ae is NOT selected; otherwise, if they requested a demo with no such constraints, decide:route_to_ae is selected."}

manifest.rationale: Judges cited that the agent routed to AE even when the prospect had already bought or needed local vendor invoicing: “Prospect said the new plan was all they needed and bought online; the AE cycle added a week and no value.” and “review: Prospect told the AE they purchase through a local vendor with in-country invoicing; closed-lost.” In each failing run, the tool call was {"action": "route_to_ae"}, which contradicts these signals. The passing runs involve explicit demo requests and appropriately used route_to_ae. This procedure adds a decision checkpoint to avoid AE routing when purchase intent is explicit or vendor/in-country invoicing is required, and preserves AE routing for genuine demo requests.

fixes.title: Fix: Unclear root-cause escalation
fixes.summary: 3 failing runs graded by jev-demo-decision-failure. Evidence: “review: Escalated later by a different team; root cause unclear.”.

corrective_entry.value:
Risk: Unclear root-cause escalation in reviews.
Evidence: Failing runs added non-causal review lines such as “review: Escalated later by a different team; root cause unclear.” and “Went badly for reasons outside the decision; flagged by the reviewing team.” These were observed even when the routing decision succeeded procedurally, and in two cases the text came from a discredited lesson (learned-mid-market-emea-5b6fddc3 v31/v35).
Guidance: Do not include review statements that report an escalation by another team or an outcome where the root cause is unclear. Only cite reviews with clear, validated causal links to the decision (e.g., partner closed/won with timeframe). If cause is unclear or external, omit the review or write: “review: Outcome unclear; not attributable to routing.” Do not quote discredited lessons in reviews.

manifest.rationale: The judge flagged all three failures for unclear, non-causal review text: “review: Escalated later by a different team; root cause unclear.” and “Went badly for reasons outside the decision; flagged by the reviewing team.” In 81efa283 and d1035745 the agent read jev-demos/lead_routing/lh400c-s11/senselab/learned-mid-market-emea-5b6fddc3 (v35 and v31) with evidence_status “discredited” containing that same text, which the agent echoed. In 40844700, the agent produced the same unclear review despite no memory_reads, so correcting a single entry would not fix all cases. A risk belief instructing the agent not to output unclear root-cause escalations, and to only cite validated, causal reviews (as seen in passing runs like “Partner closed the deal in 24 days/30 days/32 days”), addresses the failure without disturbing successful behavior.

fixes.title: Fix: Insufficient error rationale
fixes.summary: 3 failing runs graded by jev-demo-decision-failure. Evidence: “review: Reviewer marked this one a miss; no detail recorded.”.

corrective_entry.value: {"goal": "Make and communicate a routing decision with explicit, customer-facing rationale.", "steps": ["Extract key signals from the lead message: company size (employees), region/timezone, industry, role/title, email domain (personal vs business), stated intent (e.g., pricing request, competitive evaluation, content interest), budget/seat count, and any constraints.", "Apply the configured routing policy using those signals to choose an action (e.g., disqualify, partner, sdr_nurture). Do not reference internal review notes when deciding.", "Compose the response with both the decision and a clear rationale that cites at least two concrete factors (e.g., personal email address; mid-market size and EMEA location with explicit pricing/seat request; content-interest only without buying request). Avoid internal/system language.", "State confidence and the why/because in one or two sentences aimed at a customer-facing reviewer."], "on_failure": "If you cannot infer enough signals to justify the decision, ask a brief clarifying question or choose the lowest-risk nurture path, and explicitly state which signals are missing (e.g., company size, intent) instead of leaving the rationale blank.", "verify": "Before sending, ensure the response includes an explicit rationale (look for 'because' or a 'rationale:' section) referencing at least two concrete factors from the lead, and does not contain internal review text such as 'Reviewer marked this one a miss; no detail recorded.'"}

manifest.rationale: Across all failing runs, the agent returned only the decision plus the reviewer note with no explanation. For example: fe0c9f53-0fe7-4623-91a6-dba3163289cb response_text shows "decision: disqualify (confidence 0.75). review: Reviewer marked this one a miss; no detail recorded."; 3d058015-373a-41a2-b323-977126d182fd shows "decision: partner (confidence 0.97). review: Reviewer marked this one a miss; no detail recorded."; fcf39e46-36b0-4587-ab51-470d8ea53617 shows "decision: sdr_nurture (confidence 0.75). review: Reviewer marked this one a miss; no detail recorded." The judge evidence also quotes "review: Reviewer marked this one a miss; no detail recorded." in each case. Two runs had no memory reads, indicating this is not a single incorrect fact but a missing step: provide rationale and avoid echoing reviewer notes. This procedure adds an explicit requirement to extract signals, apply policy, and include a clear customer-facing rationale, with a verification step that forbids including the internal reviewer note.

items.name: Unclear root-cause escalation
items.description: Issue recurs or is escalated to another team without a clear root cause identified, blocking effective remediation. Review teams flag the problem but cannot determine whether the failure stems from decision logic, external factors, or implementation gaps.

items.name: Insufficient error rationale
items.description: Agent marks or classifies an item as incorrect without providing any supporting reasoning or evidence. This leaves reviewers unable to assess the cause or reproduce the decision.

items.name: Recovered after error
items.description: A tool or step failed during the run and the agent recovered: it retried successfully, used a fallback, or told the user what went wrong.

items.name: Properly handled
items.description: The agent completed the task correctly: no judge found an unsupported claim, a missing tool call, a retry loop or an unhandled error.
